description: District name (canonical spelling from geography dataset).
Calendar year of the observation.
Calendar month number (1–12).
Reporting period in YYYY-MM format.
Total electricity units consumed in the district-month (MWh or kWh).
Total connected load in the district-month (kVA or kW).
Total number of electricity service connections in the district.
Number of service connections that received a bill in this month.
Number of DISCOMS circles present in the district.
Number of DISCOMS divisions present in the district.
Number of DISCOMS subdivisions present in the district.
Number of EV charging stations registered in the district.
Approximate latitude of the district centroid.
Approximate longitude of the district centroid.
Geographic area of the district in square kilometres.
Calendar quarter of the observation (Q1=Jan-Mar, Q2=Apr-Jun, Q3=Jul-Sep, Q4=Oct-Dec).
Telangana meteorological season: Summer (Mar-May), Monsoon (Jun-Sep), Post-Monsoon (Oct-Nov), Winter (Dec-Feb).
Full English month name derived from the month number.
Zero-based year index relative to the earliest year in the dataset. Acts as a monotone linear time regressor.
Month number (1–12), explicit alias of the source 'month' column for clarity in feature selection.
Binary flag: 1 if this row is the earliest reporting_month for the district, else 0.
formula: 1 if reporting_month == min(reporting_month) per district else 0

description: Binary flag: 1 if this row is the latest reporting_month for the district, else 0.
formula: 1 if reporting_month == max(reporting_month) per district else 0

description: EV charging station density: number of charging stations per square kilometre of district area.
Electricity intensity per charging station: monthly units consumed divided by number of charging stations. NaN if stations == 0.
Connected load per charging station (kVA/station). NaN if stations == 0.
Number of service connections per charging station. NaN if stations == 0.
Fraction of total services that were billed in the reporting month (0–1). NaN if total_services == 0.
Average electricity units consumed per total service connection. NaN if total_services == 0.
Average connected load per total service connection (kVA). NaN if total_services == 0.
Average electricity units consumed per *billed* service connection. NaN if billed_services == 0.
Electricity units from the immediately preceding month for the same district (lag-1). NaN for the first observation per district.
Connected load from the immediately preceding month for the same district (lag-1). NaN for the first observation per district.
3-month trailing mean of units for the district, computed over the 3 months preceding the current month (t-3 to t-1). Historical only.
6-month trailing mean of units for the district (t-6 to t-1). Historical only.
12-month trailing mean of units for the district (t-12 to t-1). Historical only.
3-month trailing standard deviation of units (t-3 to t-1). NaN if fewer than 3 prior observations exist for the district.
6-month trailing standard deviation of units (t-6 to t-1). NaN if fewer than 6 prior observations exist for the district.
6-month trailing maximum of units (t-6 to t-1). NaN if fewer than 6 prior observations exist for the district.
6-month trailing minimum of units (t-6 to t-1). NaN if fewer than 6 prior observations exist for the district.
Month-on-month percentage change in electricity units for the district: 100 × (units_t − units_{t-1}) / units_{t-1}. NaN for the first observation or when previous month units == 0.
Month-on-month percentage change in connected load for the district. NaN for the first observation or when previous month load == 0.
Running total of electricity units consumed by the district from its first observation up to the month preceding the current month.
Running total of connected load for the district from its first observation up to the month preceding the current month.
